tools.name: docs_query
tools.description: Run a read-only, shell-style command against a virtual filesystem that holds only the Whop documentation pages. It is not a shell on any real machine. Use ls or tree to explore, rg for exact matches, and head or cat to read a page that docs_search returned (append .mdx to its path). Example: head -100 /developer/guides/ai_and_mcp.mdx. Cite pages at https://docs.whop.com without the .mdx extension.

command.description: The command to run, for example `tree / -L 2`, `rg -il "webhook" /developer`, or `head -80 /payments/overview.mdx`.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search the Whop documentation at docs.whop.com: guides, API reference, webhooks, SDKs, and product help. Returns matching excerpts with page paths and links. Use it for how-to and concept questions, or to learn a field or endpoint before calling an operation tool. Read a full page with docs_query.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

version.description: Restrict results to one documentation version. Omit to search the current docs.
